winks.rationale: The surname 'Thoreau' is exactly the name of the town of Thoreau, New Mexico (a real incorporated community).
The surname 'Faulkner' is exactly the name of Faulkner County, Arkansas.
The surname 'Fenn' is exactly the name of the small community of Fenn, Idaho.
The word 'Alexander' is exactly the name of Alexander County, North Carolina (and Alexander City, AL).
The surname 'Whitman' is exactly the name of Whitman County, Washington (and Whitman, MA).
The surname 'Melville' is exactly the name of towns such as Melville, Montana and Melville, NY.
The surname 'Hugo' is exactly the name of Hugo, Colorado (and Hugo, OK / MN).
The surname 'Gould' is exactly the name of Gould, Arkansas (and Gould, OK).
The surname 'Lewis' is exactly the name of multiple Lewis Counties and the town of Lewiston.
The 'Black' half of the hyphenated surname is the name of features/towns such as Black Mountain, NC.
The 'Collins' half of the surname is the name of US places like Fort Collins, CO and Collins, MS.
'Augustine' shares the same Latin root and near-sound as Augusta, GA/ME, though the exact word also yields St. Augustine, FL.
The surname 'Carnegie' is exactly the name of towns such as Carnegie, Oklahoma and Carnegie, PA.
The surname 'Tiffany' is the name of small communities such as Tiffany, Colorado.
